column1: # The declared ReviewBench base/head world archives (VAL-REVIEW-002).
# One line per acquired world: `archive <world> <mirror repository> <revision> <sha256> <bytes>`.
# Emitted by the real acquisition of the pinned cohort's exact base and head commits from the
# canonical `review-bench` source mirrors; the acquisition repository rule verifies each declared
# digest before the bytes enter the study, so a mutated or substituted archive fails the fetch.
# Owned by Attune.Study.ReviewBench (the world identity, the mirror convention and the exported
# revision are derived from the task, never restated as truth here).
